picks.what: The Kale quarter and the Black Sea, colored postcard
picks.why: color view over the old town to the sea, with the vanished Aya Triada church

gaps: P0–P3: nothing; P5: only Atatürk visits, a group of fighters and a building in Vezirköprü; P6: only close-ups of the Panorama 1919 Museum
notes: Alternative P4: #2 (B&W postcard ‘Souvenir de Samsoun. Vue panoramique’), a better whole-city panorama along the bay, but its Commons date 1851 comes from a caption added by a modern publisher and is impossible for a picture postcard; it is really about 1900–1914, so not used. Source of #5 is small (908 px wide).
